So answer: integrations continue unchanged, no reconfiguration needed; automation rules continue, but if they use tier-gated features not in new tier they will be paused, not deleted, and will reactivate if upgrade. function.name: post_reply

arguments.message:
Moving your workspace to a new plan won’t break your existing integrations – API keys, webhooks and any automation rules stay linked to the workspace’s underlying ID, so they keep running without any re‑configuration.

The only thing that can change is a rule that relies on a feature that’s only available on the destination tier. In that case the rule is automatically paused (not deleted) and will reactivate if you later move back to a tier that includes the feature. You can see the status of every rule before you confirm the migration in **Settings → Automation → Rules**.

So, integrations carry over untouched, and automation rules generally continue unchanged unless they depend on a tier‑gated capability that isn’t included in the new plan.
